title: How Debate Outlines Work
text:
A debate outline is a plan that helps a speaker organize their arguments before a debate begins. It usually starts with a clear claim, which is the main point the speaker wants to prove. Under the claim, the speaker writes reasons and evidence that support it. A good outline also includes a short list of possible counterarguments, so the speaker can prepare answers in advance.

Many students find that outlines make them feel more confident. When they know what they will say, they spend less time searching for words during the round. Teachers often ask students to write their outlines on one page, because this forces them to choose only the strongest ideas. Some debaters also practice by reading their outline aloud to a partner.

options: To force students to choose the strongest ideas

questions.text: What can the reader infer about students who have a prepared outline?
options: They will probably speak with less hesitation during a debate
They do not need any evidence
They will always win the debate

questions.text: Why might a speaker include counterarguments in an outline?
options: To agree with the opponent immediately
To prepare answers to objections in advance

paragraph_translations: Un esquema de debate es un plan que ayuda a un orador a organizar sus argumentos antes de que comience el debate. Normalmente empieza con una afirmación clara, que es el punto principal que el orador quiere demostrar. Debajo de la afirmación, el orador escribe razones y evidencias que la apoyan. Un buen esquema también incluye una lista breve de posibles contraargumentos, para que el orador pueda preparar respuestas con antelación.

Muchos estudiantes descubren que los esquemas les dan más confianza. Cuando saben lo que van a decir, pasan menos tiempo buscando palabras durante la ronda. Los profesores suelen pedir a los estudiantes que escriban sus esquemas en una sola página, porque esto les obliga a elegir solo las ideas más fuertes. Algunos debatientes también practican leyendo su esquema en voz alta a un compañero.
